problem.title: Sum of Alternate Elements in a Range
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers and multiple queries, determine the sum of elements at alternate positions within each specified range, starting from the left endpoint.
problem.input: • First line contains N. • Second line contains N integers. • Third line contains Q. • Next Q lines each contain L and R.
problem.output: • For each query, print the required sum.
